caption: The drawing consists of two adjacent rectangular panels placed side by side. Each panel features a stylized, geometric tree with a straight trunk, symmetrical branches, round fruit, and large pointed leaves. Below the trees, a picket fence spans the width of each panel. On the left panel, the background is filled with a solid dark blue color while the tree and fence are rendered in an off-white shade. On the right panel, the colors are inverted: the background is off-white and the tree along with the fence are dark blue. Both panels are bordered by a wide margin of off-white space, and a signature appears in the lower right area of the drawing.
title: Tyler Coverlet
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
